## Description

Optimizes weights to maximize the portfolio diversification ratio (weighted average asset volatility relative to portfolio volatility).

## Where it may fit

Multi-asset portfolios where correlation diversification is valuable and expected-return estimates are unreliable.

## Vehicles

Multi-asset, ETF, risk-based and institutional allocation portfolios.

## Required data

Asset covariance/volatility estimates, constraints, prices/returns and rebalance calendar.

## Caveats

Covariance estimation and constraints affect weights; optimization does not guarantee best return or protection in correlation spikes.
